permit.first: The Ministry of Labour must first find that no Liberian is qualified for the post and that it has been duly advertised (the Civil Service Agency's 2024 report).

sources.title: Civil Service Agency (Liberia), A Report from the Analysis of the Alien Work Permit 2024 (June 2025)
sources.said: before issuing a work permit, the Ministry of Labor must have asserted that the position for which a permit is being sought: - No Liberian is qualiﬁed for it. - Has been duly advertised
